subs.zh: 黄河在这里走出峡谷，奔向平原。
subs.en: Here, the Yellow River leaves its gorges and spreads across the plain.

subs.zh: 这片中原腹地，就是郑州。
subs.en: This heartland of the Central Plains is Zhengzhou.

subs.zh: 它的故事，要从八千年前说起。
subs.en: Its story begins eight thousand years ago.

subs.zh: 在新郑裴李岗，先民磨制石器、种下粟米；
subs.en: At Peiligang, early people ground stone tools and planted millet;

subs.zh: 大河村彩陶上的太阳纹，记录着五千年前的天空。
subs.en: sun motifs on Dahecun pottery recorded the sky of five thousand years ago.

subs.zh: 传说中，人文始祖黄帝也诞生在这片土地。
subs.en: Legend says the Yellow Emperor was born on this land.

subs.zh: 约三千六百年前，商朝在这里筑起都城。
subs.en: About 3,600 years ago, the Shang dynasty built a capital here.

subs.zh: 近七公里的夯土城墙，至今仍立在城市中心，
subs.en: Nearly seven kilometres of rammed-earth walls still stand downtown,

subs.zh: 出土的青铜方鼎，见证着早期中国的模样。
subs.en: and bronze cauldrons unearthed here show what early China looked like.

subs.zh: 周代，这里是管国，郑州至今别称“管城”。
subs.en: Under the Zhou it was the State of Guan, so Zhengzhou is still called Guancheng.

subs.zh: 春秋战国，郑国、韩国先后建都新郑。
subs.en: In the Spring and Autumn and Warring States eras, Zheng and Han made Xinzheng their capital.

subs.zh: 公元五八三年，隋朝设立郑州，名字沿用至今。
subs.en: In 583 AD, the Sui dynasty named it Zhengzhou, a name it still bears.

subs.zh: 这里文脉绵长：诗圣杜甫生于巩义，白居易生于新郑；
subs.en: Its culture runs deep: the poet Du Fu was born in Gongyi, Bai Juyi in Xinzheng;

subs.zh: 嵩山脚下的少林寺，晨钟暮鼓已有一千五百多年。
subs.en: at the foot of Mount Song, Shaolin Temple's bells have rung for over 1,500 years.

subs.zh: 二十世纪初，京汉、汴洛两条铁路在这里交汇，
subs.en: In the early 1900s, the Beijing–Hankou and Kaifeng–Luoyang railways met here,

subs.zh: 一座小县城，被火车拉成了交通枢纽。
subs.en: and trains turned a small county town into a transport hub.

subs.zh: 一九二三年的二七大罢工，让二七塔成为城市的记忆。
subs.en: The February 7th strike of 1923 made the Erqi Tower the city's landmark of memory.

subs.zh: 一九五四年，河南省会从开封迁到郑州，
subs.en: In 1954, Henan's provincial capital moved from Kaifeng to Zhengzhou,

subs.zh: 国棉厂的织机声日夜不停，它有了“纺织城”的名号，
subs.en: its cotton mills hummed day and night, earning it the name "Textile City",

subs.zh: 这座城市从此一路生长。
subs.en: and the city has been growing ever since.

subs.zh: 今天，“米”字形高铁网从这里通向四面八方，
subs.en: Today, a star-shaped high-speed rail network radiates from here in every direction,

subs.zh: 航空港连接世界，常住人口超过一千三百万。
subs.en: its airport links the world, and more than thirteen million people call it home.

subs.zh: 从裴李岗的炊烟，到高铁的汽笛，
subs.en: From the cooking smoke of Peiligang to the whistle of bullet trains,

subs.zh: 郑州始终站在中华文明的十字路口。
subs.en: Zhengzhou has always stood at the crossroads of Chinese civilisation.

subs.zh: 这，就是郑州的前世今生。
subs.en: This is Zhengzhou, past and present.
